entries.subject: The radio hour wants {client}
entries.body:
[i]“Fifteen minutes on the air, a fan-magazine spread to follow, and every soda fountain in America talking about it. The sponsors adore {client} — don't make me tell them no.”[/i]

Radio is live, national and unforgiving. One flubbed line travels further than ten good pictures.

choices.label: Pass — keep the mystery

effects.text: You pass on the radio hour for {client}. The sponsors sigh, audibly.

choices.outcome: The slot goes to a rival's client. Their voice, their risk, their fifteen minutes.

entries.subject: The late show wants {client} on the couch
entries.body:
[i]“Live television, twenty million living rooms, one couch. {client} charms the host and owns the week — or stumbles once and owns the week anyway, the other way.”[/i]

Live TV is the fastest heat in the business, and heat burns in both directions.

choices.label: Decline — film stars don't do television

effects.text: {client} skips the late show. The host makes a joke about it on air.

choices.outcome: The host fills ninety seconds with jokes about empty couches. The audience laughs. Twice.

entries.subject: An at-home story on {client} — friendly, promise
entries.body:
[i]“Full-color spread, eight pages, {client} at home with the dogs and the espresso machine. We shoot Tuesday. And of course my editor will want a little... texture. Readers love texture.”[/i]

The boulevard press pays in reach and collects in privacy. The interest rate is brutal.

choices.label: Keep the front door shut

effects.text: No at-home story for {client}. The magazine will find its texture elsewhere — possibly about you.

choices.outcome: The editor's reply is one line: “We'll manage without access.” That sentence has teeth.

entries.subject: Live Q&A: {client}, trending by Friday
entries.body:
[i]“One hour, live, unfiltered — {client} answering fan questions on stream. The algorithm is hungry and it likes faces it already knows. We clip the best moments and ride the feed all weekend.”[/i]

Everything is content now. Including, if the hour goes wrong, the going-wrong.

choices.label: Stay off the feed

effects.text: {client} stays off the stream. The algorithm forgets faces fast.

choices.outcome: No stream, no clips, no risk. Also: no heat. The feed scrolls on without you.
